sales-14 / 確認済みの事実と不明点を分ける: sales-14 / Separate confirmed facts from unknowns
営業担当者から「メールのURLを開くと読み込みが続いたので閉じた」と連絡がありま: A salesperson reports opening a URL from an email, then closing it because it kept loading. A Proxy notification also arrived because the domain was newly observed. Distinguish connection permission from actual download or execution, and report what can currently be established and what still needs checking.
Proxyは要求ポリシーと応答の監査を別の収集器へ送る。response-col: The Proxy sends request-policy and response audits to separate collectors. On restart, response-collector discards the preceding two minutes of its memory buffer and cannot resend that interval to the central platform. policy_decision=allow at request time records a decision not to block the connection. Response status and transfer volume belong to the separate response audit. The EDR process_audit_watermark is the latest process-audit timestamp received centrally. newly_observed is a first-seen classification.

悪性や取得・実行の成否を確定できない場合、確認済みの要求と不足記録を分けて追加調: If maliciousness or download/execution success cannot be established, separate confirmed requests from missing records and hand off for further investigation. Do not ask the user to reopen the URL to check. Once safe investigation is possible, check browser history, download records, and process history around the action time, and whether Proxy response records can be restored. Preserve the original email too.

調べる端末のログに絞る: Filter the logs to the device under investigation
ログはシステムが残した出来事の記録です。このボタンで、対象端末 scan-lab: Logs are records of events left by a system. This button shows only records for the target device, scan-lab-01.
「ログ検索」に切り替わり、端末の絞り込みが設定されました。: Log search is now open with the device filter applied.
ログの検索欄に「検査」と入力してください。: Enter inspection in the log search field.
関係する記録だけに絞り込めます。通常の勤務では、ユーザー名やIPアドレスでも検索: This narrows the view to relevant records. During regular shifts, you can also search by username or IP address.
検査に関係するログが残りました。「資産検査の実施範囲を確認」という記録を詳しく読: Only inspection-related logs remain. Examine the record named Verified asset inspection scope.
実際に行われた検査の記録を読む: Read the record of the inspection actually performed
「資産検査の実施範囲を確認」の「生ログを表示」を押してください。: Select Show raw log for Verified asset inspection scope.
JSON の run が INV-310 なのは作業の実行ID、targets: In the JSON, run=INV-310 is the work's execution ID, targets lists its destinations, and dst_port=443 is the destination port. outside_scope_connections=0 is the count of out-of-scope connections recorded by this inspection job itself. You will compare this with the request later to establish whether it matches the approved scope.
元の記録を開けました。このログだけで正当と決めず、後で他の根拠と結び付けます。: You have opened the original record. Do not conclude that the work was authorized from this log alone; connect it with other evidence later.
このログを、判断の根拠として残す: Keep this log to support your assessment
同じ「資産検査の実施範囲を確認」の「証拠に追加」を押してください。: Select Add to evidence for the same Verified asset inspection scope record.
「対応記録」の「登録した証拠」に保存されます。後で「何を見て判断したか」を報告に: It is saved under Registered evidence in the Response record. This lets you include what you examined to reach your conclusion in the report.
1つ目の証拠が登録されました。ログは検査の実施範囲を示していますが、その作業が承: Your first piece of evidence is saved. The log shows the inspection's actual scope, but you must also check whether the work was approved.
端末の用途と、予定された作業を知る: Understand the device's purpose and the planned work
台帳には端末の役割、作業申請には承認済みの作業が記録されています。今回の端末は、: The inventory records the device's role, while work requests record approved activities. This device is dedicated to checking whether the test servers are reachable.
資料を開けました。次は、ログの時刻・対象・操作を作業申請と比べます。: The records are open. Next, compare the log's time, targets, and operations with the work request.
一致する作業申請を証拠にする: Add the matching work request as evidence
「資産検査申請 REQ-310」を読み、その「証拠に追加」を押してください。: Read Asset inspection request REQ-310, then select its Add to evidence button.
申請は08:50〜09:10に、10.24.90.21〜24 の4台の TCP: The request specifies an inspection from 08:50 to 09:10, connecting to TCP 443 on four devices, 10.24.90.21–24. The execution time of 08:52, four destinations, and operations match the logs. All timestamps in the logs and records use UTC.
2つ目の証拠が登録されました。ただし申請は予定です。担当者に、実際に何をしたかも: Your second piece of evidence is saved. A request is a plan, however. Also ask the owner what they actually did.
照会は、別の担当者に事実を確認することです。ここでは検証環境担当の森田さんに、検: Contacting an owner means asking another person to verify facts. Here you can ask Morita, the test environment owner, about the inspection and its results.
確認の依頼先が分かりました。次のボタンで、演習内の担当者へ依頼できます。: You have identified whom to ask. The next button sends a request to the simulated owner in this exercise.
「確認を依頼する」を押し、届いた回答を読んでください。: Select Request confirmation, then read the reply.
これは教材内の模擬連絡です。このチュートリアルでは待ち時間なしで返信されます。通: This communication is simulated within the learning material. The tutorial replies immediately. In regular Medium and High difficulty shifts, investigate other cases while waiting for replies.
森田さんは、REQ-310 に沿った作業を実施し、INV-310 が申請どおりの: Morita confirms performing the work under REQ-310 and verifying that INV-310 completed with connections only to the four requested devices. This connects the reply to the logs and request.
回答も証拠として残す: Keep the reply as evidence too
森田さんの回答の下にある「証拠に追加」を押してください。: Select Add to evidence below Morita's reply.
実行ID INV-310 もログと一致しています。ログ・作業申請・担当者の回答と: Execution ID INV-310 also matches the logs. Combine the separate evidence sources: the logs, work request, and owner's reply.
3つの証拠がそろいました。ここから調査結果を「対応記録」にまとめます。: You now have three pieces of evidence. Summarize the investigation in the Response record.
集めた3つの根拠を確認する: Review the three pieces of evidence
「対応記録」の「登録した証拠」を確認し、「次へ」を押してください。: Review Registered evidence in the Response record, then select Next.
ログが示す接続の範囲と操作は申請と一致し、担当者も実施と完了を確認しています。申: The connection scope and operations shown in the logs match the request, and the owner confirms execution and completion. The key is verifying that the actual work stayed within the approved scope, rather than deciding only from the existence of a request.
次は、証拠から導いた判断を記録します。: Next, record the assessment you reached from the evidence.
今回は承認済みの資産検査です。短時間に接続先が増えたという理由だけで攻撃と決めま: This was an approved asset inspection. A rapid increase in destinations alone does not establish an attack.
正当な業務による事象として判定を記録しました。: You have recorded the verdict as Authorized activity.
確認後の対応優先度を決める: Set the response priority after investigation
承認された範囲内での検査完了を確認できました。左の「検知：中」は機械が付けた重要: You have confirmed that the inspection completed within its approved scope. Detection: Medium on the left is the severity assigned by the detection system. Your response priority after investigation may differ.
調査結果に基づく対応優先度を記録しました。: You have recorded the response priority based on your findings.
どの端末についての判断かを残す: Record which device your assessment concerns
担当者が交代しても、どの端末について調査したのか分かるようにします。: This ensures that another owner can tell which device you investigated.
調査対象を記録しました。: You have recorded the investigation target.
この案件の次の対応を選ぶ: Choose the next response for this case
「次の対応」で「根拠を添えてクローズ」を選んでください。: Under Next response, select Close with supporting evidence.
クローズは、根拠を残して案件の確認を終えることです。今回は、セキュリティ上の隔離: Closing a case means ending its investigation while retaining the evidence. In this case, you can determine that security isolation or account suspension is unnecessary.
案件を根拠付きで終了する方針を記録しました。: You have recorded the decision to close the case with supporting evidence.
何が分かり、なぜそう判断したかを書く: Write what you found and why you reached your conclusion
「確認した事実・判断の理由」に入力してください。下の「この欄に入力例を入れる」も: Complete Confirmed facts & reasoning. You can also use Fill this field with an example below it.
事実と根拠をつないで報告します。例文を入れた後に、自分の言葉へ直しても構いません: Connect the facts with the evidence in your report. After inserting the example, you can rewrite it in your own words.
調査で確認した事実と、判断の理由を記録しました。: You have recorded the confirmed facts and the reasons for your assessment.
scan-lab-01 からの複数接続は資産検査 INV-310 によるものだっ: The multiple connections from scan-lab-01 were part of asset inspection INV-310. The four targets, TCP 443 connections, and execution time of 08:52 in the logs matched the approved scope of asset inspection request REQ-310. Morita also confirmed the execution scope and completion, so I assessed this as authorized activity.
案件を閉じた後の引き継ぎを残す: Leave a handoff for after the case closes
「未確認事項・引き継ぎ」に入力してください。この欄にも入力例を用意しています。: Complete Open questions & handoff. An example is available for this field too.
今回の確認結果がどこまで通用するかも残します。自由記述の意味は自動採点されないた: Record the limits of this finding's applicability. The meaning of free text is not graded automatically, so compare it with the example report during your review.
次の担当者が何をするかまで記録できました。: You have also recorded what the next owner should do.
実施範囲のログ、作業申請、担当者の回答を根拠にクローズする。今回の確認だけで同じ: Close using the scope log, work request, and owner's reply as evidence. Do not use this finding to allow all future traffic from the same device; investigate any connections outside the request as a separate case.
判断と対応を記録して、案件を完了する: Record the assessment and response to complete the case
証拠・判定・対象・対応がそろっているかを確認します。ボタンを押すまでは下書きです: The check verifies that evidence, verdict, target, and response are present. Your entries remain a draft until you select the button. No real system settings are changed and no external messages are sent.
案件が「対応済み」になりました。「次へ」で、この調査の流れを振り返りましょう。: The case is now Handled. Select Next to review the investigation process.
最初の調査を、最後までできました: You completed your first investigation from start to finish
依頼を読む → ログを調べる → 資料・担当者と照合 → 証拠を残す → 判断と: Read the request → examine logs → compare with records and the owner → keep evidence → record the assessment and response. Select Finish and choose a shift, then try this sequence yourself.
この専用問題は操作を覚えるため、判断の理由と入力例を案内しました。通常勤務では別: This dedicated case provided reasoning and example entries to teach the controls. Regular shifts use different cases, where you independently distinguish security incidents, authorized activity, and cases with insufficient evidence for a conclusion.
通常勤務の進捗は変更していません。終了すると、元の勤務選択へ戻れます。: Your regular-shift progress has not changed. Finishing returns you to the original shift selection screen.
